azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.title: Selected App Service and Function literal app settings have no detected secrets
azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.description: Inspect literal application settings only for explicitly selected App Service/Azure Function sites or deployment slots using both offline detectors.
azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected app settings and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use managed identity or Key Vault references where appropriate.
azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.purpose: Only selected observed literal settings are inspected; references are excluded without dereference and credential validity is not checked.
azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.missing_observation: Selected supported literal settings could not be completely read, bound and scanned with both offline detectors.
azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in selected literal app settings.
azure.review.app_service.selected_app_se.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in selected literal app settings. The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.
